Former Cricketer Praises Young Player as Jadeja's Successor

Former cricketer Akash Chopra has identified 24-year-old Manav Suthar as a potential successor to all-rounder Ravindra Jadeja. Chopra described Suthar as an 'upgraded version' of Jadeja. The praise for Suthar, a left-arm spinner, comes amid discussions about emerging talent in Indian cricket.
